label: .NET 11 SDK
description: The .NET SDK, installed side by side with any other .NET SDK you pick, with NuGet packages cached across rebuilds.

portPresets.label: ASP.NET Core
portPresets.description: Kestrel’s defaults: HTTP on 5000 and HTTPS on 5001. Projects made with dotnet new pick their own ports in Properties/launchSettings.json.

portPresets.label: .NET Aspire dashboard
portPresets.description: The Aspire dashboard on 18888, and its OpenTelemetry endpoints on 18889 (gRPC) and 18890 (HTTP). An AppHost made with dotnet new picks its own dashboard port in Properties/launchSettings.json; add that one under other ports.
